title: Throughput Ribbon: Model-Route Spike Mode & Cost Layer Prototype
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Purpose: prototype a compact performance strip for the model-and-route list/detail views that surfaces throughput spikes, latency bands, token volume and a cost overlay without requiring the user to open a full time-series canvas. The 'Throughput Ribbon' is a horizontal, multi-layered micro-chart that fits inside a model/route row and expands into a focused panel. Goals: reduce time-to-signal for ops and PMs, make cost-visible to engineers at glance, and provide a quick link into rollouts and model variants for debugging.

Scope: design of ribbon micro-chart, expanded panel interaction, spike detection visual language ('Spike Mode'), cost-per-minute layer, tooltip content, keyboard accessibility, and handoff-ready chart specs for engineering (data schema, aggregation windows, color tokens, thresholds). Not in scope: backend implementation, rollout backend endpoints (we will reference existing rollout API), or experimental A/B toggle logic.

Audience: platform engineers, SREs, ML engineers, PMs who use Console for triage and performance monitoring.
chart_specs: Ribbon composition: three stacked layers (throughput ribbon, latency band, token-area cost overlay) rendered within 56px height when compact; expands to 320px height in the detail pane.

Metrics: throughput = requests/min (1m, 5m, 15m windows), latency = p50/p95/p99 (per-request), tokens = input+output tokens summed per minute, cost = estimated $/minute based on token unit price for the route's pinned model variant.

Aggregation: primary sampling at 1-minute granularity; retention pre-aggregates at 1m/5m/15m in backend. Engineering note: if only 5m aggregates available, UI falls back to 5m and shows an explicit caveat in tooltip.

Spike detection: algorithm flags minute buckets where throughput > max(3x median(30m), p95 historical) or where sudden token-rate change > 250%. Flagged buckets are rendered with a short vertical accent bar (4px) on the ribbon and trigger 'Spike Mode' annotation in expanded view.

Latency band rendering: translucent bands for p50 (thin center line), p95 (outer band) and p99 (hairline), color-coded for severity (green/orange/red spectrum). Bands are smoothed using cubic interpolation to avoid jagged micro-noise in the ribbon view.

Cost layer: semi-opaque area chart anchored to same time axis; uses cost-per-token rate derived from route config. When user hovers, cost tooltip shows breakdown: model compute + embedding + storage if applicable.

Color tokens: throughput baseline = #2F80ED, throughput spike accent = #FF6B4A, latency bands = {p50:#27AE60, p95:#F2994A, p99:#EB5757}, cost area = #9155FF at 24% opacity; accessibility contrast checked against dark/light Console themes.
Thresholds and legends: compact legend shown on expand only; mini-legend uses iconography (bolt for spike, coin for cost, clock for latency).

Tooltips: show timestamp, throughput (1m/5m), tokens/min, latency p50/p95/p99, cost estimate/min, active model variant id, and link to last rollout for that route. Tooltip must include a 'View in full graph' CTA linking to the route's timeline page.
Missing data handling: gaps filled with dashed line and grayscale placeholder; 'data lag' state displayed when last datapoint > 3 minutes old with a small clock badge on the ribbon.
